**Verdict: PASS** for the frozen DG3 candidate `sha256:873115d9…9c33` (source `928b7654`). I raised no findings, so I wrote no findings sidecar.

**Candidate.** The candidate ID recomputes identically (753 files) at the start, at the end, at `--ref 928b7654` and in my disposable clone. HEAD differs from the source commit only by review metadata.

**What ran:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static: typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI, no-CDN, Prettier, contrast | All exit 0. The OpenAPI lint reports 270 operations. |
| Unit tests: Node 22 and Node 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 80 files / 1528 tests in every run. |
| Integration on a disposable PostgreSQL, twice | 56 files / 791 tests each run. Migrations 0001→0027 applied; every pending list is empty, so all 270 operations are live. |
| e2e on the real stack: 11 product specs, the A20 spec and my own spec, chromium-en and chromium-ar | 200/200 in each locale setting. axe found no serious or critical issues. The AUD read-only pass is included. |
| Final version of my spec on its own, both locale settings | 28/28 each. |
| `validate --register DG3`, `--pipeline`, `--historical` DG2 and DG1 | All PASS. |

**My own spec** (`docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/tests/round-1/e2e/dg3-qa-r1.spec.ts`) probes all 32 acceptance texts literally through the HTTP API, plus Arabic and English UI checks. It records 117 checks per project, and none failed. Among them:
- 5,4,3,2,1 scores 3.30, shown as 57.5 with the conversion label.
- End-to-End launch returns 422 with the exact reason until G2 and G3 are approved, then succeeds.
- The revenue example gives exactly 100000 SAR.
- Both cycles are refused, naming the cycle.
- The G4 refusal names the initiatives and lists 'Finance validation'. A submitter or non-approver gets 403, a superseded submission gets 409, and the flow ends approved by a separate synthetic Sponsor.

**Non-zero exits, all disclosed in `RUN-NOTES.md`; none is a product failure:**
- My first launch of integration run 2 was killed when its parent shell exited; I reran it properly.
- My first full e2e attempt exited 1 before any test ran, because my file filter also picked up old DG2 test copies under `docs/`. Its logs were overwritten by the corrected run.
- Trials 1–6 of my spec failed only on bugs in my own test.

**Observations (not findings):**
- When the Sponsor is the submitter of the current G4 submission, their decision on an older, superseded one gets 403 before the version check. Both outcomes refuse.
- In the API, the combined G4 refusal message repeats the label ("Finance validation Finance validation …"). The screen shows the items one by one.
- The integration tests leave about 100 scratch directories in `$TMPDIR`. This is test tidiness, not product behaviour.
- Live registry, live CI and Keycloak remain unverified here; I recorded them as PASS on the offline surface, as the assignment instructs.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- review/DG3/round-1/qa-verifier.json
- review/DG3/round-1/qa-verifier.md
- test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-1/
